ontario.basis: No Ontario percentage floor verified; university confirmation of applicant category required.

academic.text: Canadian section: GPA2.5/4.0 OR ACT22 OR SAT1120. General international section: university-assessed GPA2.5 plus English proficiency.

testing.text: SAT/ACT required for Canadian freshmen and international students attending U.S./Canadian high schools; reconfirm2028.
testing.textKo: 캐나다 신입 지원자와 미국·캐나다 고교 재학 국제 지원자는 SAT/ACT 필수. 2028년 재확인 필요.

satAlternative.remainingRequirements: Canadian category applicability must be confirmed for non-Canadian Ontario students. Secondary records, graduation, official scores, English assessment and program/financial requirements remain.
satAlternative.remainingRequirementsKo: 비캐나다 시민권자의 캐나다 지원자 기준 적용 여부를 확인해야 합니다. 고교 성적·졸업·공식 점수·영어·전공·재정 요건은 별도입니다.

entry.text: English BA with Literature is a verified degree option. Its page does not publish comparative freshman cutoffs establishing it as the easiest major.

notes: Quantitative-only audit: no additional Ontario/Canada percentage minimum or university-published Ontario grade equivalency verified among Colorado Denver, Colorado State, Montana, Montana State, South Alabama, Southern Mississippi, Louisiana Lafayette, Florida Atlantic and North Texas.

One exception retained for root consideration: Montana State Canadian Undergraduates explicitly publishes SAT1120 as an alternative to GPA2.5. Applicant-category applicability requires confirmation before treating a non-Canadian Ontario student as satisfying it.
No extra school was added only because it publishes a U.S.GPA. No grade conversion inferred.

CU Denver official first-year page gives Ontario transcript requirements and test-optional review but no verified Ontario numerical threshold: https://www.ucdenver.edu/international-admissions/apply-for-admission/undergraduate/first-year .

Colorado State official international page and undergraduate decision-factor policy use holistic GPA review; Canada references reviewed relate to English-proficiency exemptions. No Ontario percentage minimum found: https://admissions.colostate.edu/apply/international-freshmen/ .

Montana current undergraduate catalog uses U.S.GPA/class rank/curriculum conditions and separate international evaluation. No Ontario percentage threshold found: https://catalog.umt.edu/academics/undergraduate-admission/ .
South Alabama international requirements use school-calculated GPA2.5, not a Canada percentage: https://iddsg.southalabama.edu/departments/international/requirements-deadline.html .

Southern Mississippi international requirements use core GPA2.5 and country-system review; Canadian-school references are English waivers, not percentage admission minima: https://www.usm.edu/undergraduate-admissions/international-admissions/ .

Louisiana Lafayette reviewed international rules require GPA2.5 and English/math readiness; no verified Ontario grade equivalency found. Florida Atlantic and North Texas targeted official-domain Canada/Ontario admission/percentage searches yielded no applicable numerical rule. Search absence is not a claim that no such internal policy exists.
